why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Open airdrop.neosoul.ai from NeoSoul's own X post or site, and check the address.
If an amount shows, press Confirm before 22 October, 16:00 UTC. After the deadline the page shows: "The confirmation window has closed."

Wait for delivery. The page says tokens are sent within a set number of days of your first check, "and no later than Oct 23, 2026, 00:00 (UTC+8)". It also says: "Airdrops are sent in order of first airdrop queries."

Before you add DNA to a wallet or trade it, compare the contract with the one in NeoSoul's paper. Many look-alike tokens appear after a launch. Warning NeoSoul says: "NeoSoul will never DM you to ask for funds, seed phrases or private keys." Anyone who messages you about your DNA allocation isn't NeoSoul.

For future rewards, which nobody has promised, do the Questboard tasks at event.neosoul.ai . evoevo's own terms say: "New users should consider using a dedicated test wallet or a low-value wallet before connecting a wallet that holds significant assets."
